description: A10 Wave 7 — 200 Vietlish/interference review candidates. Fresh territory: question formation, existential 'have', time/date expressions, digital-life calques, food & dining, shopping, transportation, comparison & degree, numbers & quantities, direction & movement, negation, politeness & discourse, professional/academic register, false friends, kinship & address terms, redundancy patterns, connector/gerund errors. Deduped vs live(481) + waves 1-6(1065) = 1546-item denylist. Zero collisions.

entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi biết khi đến (give me know vs let me know)
entries.context: asking someone to inform you of their arrival

entries.sourcePattern: tôi vừa về đến nhà (go + arrive calque of về đến)
entries.context: announcing you have just arrived home

entries.sourcePattern: tôi hiểu rồi (already = rồi, but 'now' is more natural with stative verbs)
cửa hàng đóng cửa (adjective vs past participle)
entries.context: saying a business is not open

entries.vietlish: I am agree with your idea
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đồng ý với ý kiến (am + agree = copula + stative verb error)
tôi thông cảm với hoàn cảnh của bạn (thông cảm = sympathize/understand, over-formal calque)

entries.vietlish: my phone is out of pin
entries.sourcePattern: điện thoại hết pin (pin = battery, literal calque)
entries.context: explaining why your phone is off or unresponsive

entries.vietlish: I will try my best to complete
entries.natural: I'll do my best to complete it
entries.sourcePattern: tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức (try my best vs do my best for effort expressions)
entries.context: promising to work hard on a task

entries.sourcePattern: bài tập nhiều (much vs a lot for uncountable informal)
entries.context: complaining about a heavy homework load

entries.vietlish: I am confidence I can pass
entries.natural: I am confident I can pass
entries.sourcePattern: tôi tự tin là tôi có thể đỗ (noun 'confidence' used where adjective 'confident' is needed)

entries.vietlish: please open the air-con for me
entries.natural: please turn on the air conditioning for me
entries.sourcePattern: mở máy lạnh (mở = open, but 'turn on' for appliances)
entries.context: asking someone to turn on the air conditioning

entries.sourcePattern: thuốc làm tôi chóng mặt (subject-verb agreement error)
entries.context: describing a side effect of medication

entries.sourcePattern: tôi ăn rồi (present perfect vs simple past for recently completed action)
entries.context: saying you have already had a meal

entries.sourcePattern: lớp học bắt đầu lúc 8 giờ (subject-verb agreement)
tôi phải học nhiều hơn (must + to + infinitive error)
entries.context: saying you need to study harder

entries.vietlish: she can to speak English well
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy có thể nói tiếng Anh tốt (can + to + infinitive error)

entries.vietlish: the children make noise all day
entries.natural: the children are noisy all day
entries.sourcePattern: lũ trẻ làm ồn cả ngày (make noise vs be noisy)

entries.vietlish: can you do me a support?
entries.natural: can you give me a hand?
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có thể giúp đỡ tôi không (support as a count noun calque)
căn phòng này có mùi hôi (progressive with sensory stative verb)
entries.context: complaining about an unpleasant odour in a room

entries.sourcePattern: tôi cảm thấy đau đầu (feel + noun without article vs have a + noun)

entries.vietlish: don't worry, I will responsible for this
entries.natural: don't worry, I'll take responsibility for this
entries.sourcePattern: đừng lo, tôi sẽ chịu trách nhiệm (responsible as a predicate adjective vs take responsibility)
entries.context: reassuring someone you will handle a problem

entries.vietlish: I feel very pressure at work
entries.natural: I feel a lot of pressure at work
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cảm thấy áp lực ở công việc (pressure as uncountable mass noun without article)
để tôi giải thích điều này (let + to + infinitive error)
